data.name: Brineworks
data.description: Brineworks is an Amsterdam-based climate tech startup founded in 2023 by Gudfinnur Sveinsson and Dr. Joseph Perryman, developing a patented saltwater electrolyzer that drives ultra-low-cost Direct Air Capture while co-producing hydrogen. The CO₂ and H₂ outputs are intended for e-fuels (SAF, e-methanol) and carbon dioxide removal, with the company targeting pilot-scale commercial readiness by the end of 2026.
